selector.format: explicit array of canonical lowercase 64-hex original plan digests
selector.duplicates: refuse duplicate requested digests and distinct aliases resolving to the same original
selector.order: actual original plan digest, with requested identities paired to actual identities

policy.all: every selected original currently complete at the same frontier
policy.any: at least one selected original currently complete at the frontier
policy.attention_order: canonical actual original digest; return every cause and use the first cause as stop_reason

authority_scope: current whole-fortress grants; admit the complete requested positive horizon when unpaused and recheck at each frontier
zero_tick_behavior: inspect every selected original and explicitly capture eligible exact reserve endpoints after complete selection and output admission; do not advance or dispatch
records: complete scalar selected-plan projections at one current frontier in canonical original order

admission_order: resolve and validate the entire selection
admit the complete source union and evaluation work
render complete selected evidence, objectives, retained work and Agent Turn
admit the full response before any endpoint append
publication.endpoint_storage: independent immutable original E records in canonical selection order
publication.later_append_failure: halt, retain every earlier successfully published endpoint, discard unpublished candidate metadata and report incomplete publication with actual progress
publication.after_final_append: return the already admitted packet without fallible fitting or projection
publication.error_currentness: full selected identities and real elapsed progress remain visible under current read authority; incomplete inspection cannot claim group completion

budgets.source_union: current world plus distinct exact historical endpoint snapshots plus complete retained original and selected custody sources
budgets.selected_proof_accounting: conservative upper bound, separately labeled from measured source work
budgets.repeated_inspection_accounting: report checked accumulated measured work; do not grant an independent source allowance to each member

replay.arguments: preserve exact caller plan_digests array and optional plan_policy
replay.malformed_types: refuse the whole transcript before opening a replay session
replay.well_typed_semantic_refusals: reexecute the exact rejected selection without changing it to an ordinary duration wait

compatibility.passive_tasks: continue to accept one exact plan_digest with zero time; selected sets use foreground wait
